page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with a running head at the top and page number at the top right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nacia in errore semel-coepto. 2 Thess. 2. v. 10. seq.
Candor est, quo bona in quoque sincere agnoscuntur; aliorum & dicta & facta, ambigua præsertim, in meliorem partem exponuntur. 1 Cor. 13 v.6.7. Tit.3.v.2.

Illi adversatur: Temeritas in damnando, Matt.7.v.1. Dolus malus in aliorum dictis & factis depravandis, Matt.26.v 60. Curiositas in arcanis aliorum scrutandis, atq; Futilitas in iisdem evulgandis: Prov.11.v.13. itemq; Adulatio, Prov.27. v.14. Roman. 16.v.18.
main_text.head: Hactenus quomodo proximi boni promovendi facto studere debeamus.
main_text.p: Decimo demum præcepto: affectuum rectitudo sancitur; pravæq; cupiditates inhibentur.
Affectuum q: facultatis, cum appetentis, tum iracentis.
Appetentis sunt: Gaudium, Spes, & Amor; in bonis: contra, Mœstitia, Metus, atq; Odium; in malis. Rom.13. v.14. Eph.4.v.23. 1 Thess.5.v.23. 1 Tim.1.v.5;

page.notes: The Greek word at the end of the page is partly illegible in the scan; the transcription of "Ἀπιχαιρεκακία" is approximate. The letter at the foot is a signature-like mark, given as printed. Some marginal-looking show-through from the reverse side was ignored.
